subject: [PATCH v2 03/17] selftests/mm: skip khugepaged page cache cases without a PMD folio

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged test suite to skip certain cases related to khugepaged page cache when a PMD folio is not supported. The issue arises from a global cap on page cache order, which prevents PMD-sized page cache folios and causes the kernel to refuse collapses in these cases. The patch adds checks for this condition and skips shmem and file operations if a PMD-order page cache folio is not supported. If no operations are left to collapse into, the test suite exits with a skip message.
